systems.owner: Information and Documentation Centre, Ministry of Education, in cooperation with UNICEF Libya
systems.tiers: Not in use: a first workshop on the system was held on 29 March 2023, where UNICEF's consultant set out what would be needed to localise it in Libya

note: No fact: the document reports a first introductory workshop on OpenEMIS and says only that it has uses for the student, the teacher, school management and ministry supervisors and yields local and international indicators; it does not say what schools would enter, so the system is unclassified.
